name: North Slope (Dingford) Route

pitch_detail.notes: Bushwhack through forest/brush to a talus slope below granite cliffs, then down 'Snowflake Lane' cleft to Big Snow Lake.
pitch_detail.pitch: Myrtle Lake to Big Snow Lake

pitch_detail.notes: Traverse via a heather bench around Snowflake Lake toward the base of the summit gully.
Moderately steep stream gully/snow couloir on crumbly, mossy rock, talus, and polished slabs, gaining the northwest flank and northeast summit ridge.

permit: Free self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit at the trailhead; no quota or fee. Northwest Forest Pass to park at most trailheads.

approach_logistics.trailhead: Dingford Creek Trailhead (Middle Fork Snoqualmie Road)
approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: From the Dingford Creek Trailhead up the Middle Fork Snoqualmie Road from North Bend
